crmInstructions.zapier:
1. Go to zapier.com → "Create Zap"
2. Trigger: "Webhooks by Zapier" → "Catch Hook"
3. Copy the generated URL and paste it above
4. Action: connect to your favorite CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, etc.)
crmInstructions.make:
1. Go to make.com → "Create a new scenario"
2. Add the "Webhooks" module → "Custom Webhook"
3. Copy the generated URL and paste it above
4. Connect to your CRM in the next module
crmInstructions.gohighlevel:
1. Go to Settings → Integrations → Webhooks
2. Click "Add Webhook"
3. Paste the ZyraVoice URL
4. Select the events: Contact Created, Call Ended
crmInstructions.hubspot:
1. Go to Settings → Integrations → Private Apps
2. Create an app and copy the Webhook URL
3. Or use Zapier/Make as an intermediary for more flexibility
crmInstructions.monday:
1. Go to your Board → Integrations → Webhooks
2. Create an incoming webhook
3. Copy the generated URL and paste it above
crmInstructions.airtable:
1. Airtable has no direct native webhooks
2. Use Make or Zapier as an intermediary
3. In Make: "Airtable" module → "Create a Record"
4. In Zapier: Action → Airtable → "Create Record"
crmInstructions.notion:
1. Notion has no native webhooks
2. Use Make or Zapier as an intermediary
3. In Make: "Notion" module → "Create a Database Item"
4. In Zapier: Action → Notion → "Create Database Item"
crmInstructions.pipedrive:
1. Go to Tools → Webhooks → "Add Webhook"
2. Or use Zapier for more flexibility
3. Copy the URL and paste it above
crmInstructions.salesforce:
1. Use Zapier or Make as an intermediary
2. In Zapier: Action → Salesforce → "Create Record"
3. Map the fields from the ZyraVoice payload
crmInstructions.n8n:
1. Create a workflow → "Add first step" → "On webhook call"
2. Copy the generated webhook URL
3. Paste it above and connect to your CRM in the next node
crmInstructions.custom:
Your server will receive a POST with a ZyraVoice JSON payload.
Verify authenticity with the X-ZyraVoice-Signature header (HMAC SHA-256).
Example: X-ZyraVoice-Signature: sha256=<hex>
